products.name: Alsona
products.tagline: AI agents that turn buying signals into booked sales calls
products.description: 95% of prospects aren't ready to buy when you reach out. Alsona finds the ones showing buying intent right now. It tracks 32+ signals across hiring, funding, tech changes, reviews, ad spend, and more, then scores companies against your ICP and explains why they're worth contacting. AI agents turn those signals into personalized LinkedIn and email outreach, helping you start conversations while the buying window is open. Alsona helps you book calls directly with the 5% who is ready to buy today.

products.name: Maxma
products.tagline: The 24/7 AI teammate that scales your paid ad performance
products.description: Maxma is the AI platform that 10Xs your human marketers. It does the end-to-end work of paid advertising, from analyzing performance, creating ads and landing pages, and launching and optimizing campaigns across channels, to managing tracking and reporting. Working like a teammate in Slack, on demand or proactively 24/7, it proposes changes for approval and drives measurable, incremental growth across Google, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, ChatGPT Ads, and more. So lean teams can grow without limits.

products.name: TK by Medium
products.tagline: An agentic notebook to build your best thinking
products.description: What if every thought had the chance to become something extraordinary? Meet TK, the agentic notebook by Medium. Capture every spark, from shower thoughts to forgotten notes. With AI right where you write, connect the dots, surface new possibilities, and compound what you know without breaking your flow. Then turn your thinking into writing that’s unmistakably yours. With built-in community and an MCP server that connects to your favorite LLMs and AI tools.

products.name: Latch.ai
products.tagline: Automate complex accounting work without a single prompt
products.description: Latch is built for accountants buried in click-heavy close work. Instead of writing prompts, you do a task on screen and talk it through, including the parts no SOP captures: the three-day matching window, the rate you always override. Latch asks about the exceptions, then builds a sidekick that runs the task the same way every time, right in the tools you already use. When something doesn't fit, it stops and asks you. Every step is logged for review.

products.name: Seldon
products.tagline: Behavioral QA agents that use your product like customers do
products.description: Find the tests you didn’t know to write. Tell Wren what should work in plain English. Its QA agents try the paths your customers take, like going back to change an address halfway through checkout or retrying a failed payment. When something breaks, you get a replay and the steps to reproduce the bug. First 10 runs free.

products.name: Opal Reader
products.tagline: Read PDFs and EPUBs on iPhone Duo
products.description: Opal Reader is a PDF and EPUB reader with a notebook beside the page. On iPhone Duo, unfold to read your book and your notes together, then fold it closed and keep reading in a compact view with your place saved. Also available on iPhone and iPad.

products.name: Lottie AI
products.tagline: Editable vector animations from a text prompt
products.description: Motion generated as editable vector animation, built with builders in mind. Get a lightweight Lottie you can recolor, restyle and resize without regenerating, with custom controls for every animation. Add hover and click interactions with a simple prompt. Start with Turbo for quick ideas, or switch to Quality when you have a solid plan. No motion-design skills needed. Export to dotLottie, JSON, GIF, video and more.

products.name: Ember
products.tagline: Free, open-source Slack you host on Cloudflare in one click
products.description: Open Source Slack and Campfire inspired chat with one click deploy to Cloudflare. Slack-compatible payloads, AI assistant, media attachments, all built-in and hosted for $0 on Cloudflare free tiers.

products.name: Co-Review
products.tagline: Read the whole repository with the agent that built it
products.description: Agent-built code works but stops feeling like yours. Co-Review opens the whole repository as a review: comment on a line, file or folder, ask why, and the agent answers from the code. Also reviews diffs, PRs and designs. Free, open source, no telemetry.

products.name: Coffee
products.tagline: A quiet Markdown editor for Mac, with sums in your notes
products.description: Coffee is a native Mac Markdown editor. Your notes stay plain Markdown files in a folder you choose. Answers to sums appear beside the line, maths and Mermaid diagrams are drawn natively, and you review every change an AI tool makes to a note. 14 days free.

products.name: ChromePing
products.tagline: Talk to anyone by phone, in a language you don't speak
products.description: Move somewhere you don't speak the language and the phone becomes a wall — the immigration office, your bank, a landlord, a clinic, even ordering food. The usual fix is bringing a human translator, if you can find one. ChromePing lets you call any real phone number — mobile or landline, anywhere — from your browser. No app to install, yours or theirs. The call is translated live, both ways, with captions. Whoever you call just answers their normal phone. Pay as you go, no subscription.

products.name: MuJoCo 4
products.tagline: A physics engine for robots with its own studio
products.description: MuJoCo 4 is a major update to Google DeepMind's open-source physics engine. It adds a modular 3D Studio, improved deformable-body simulation, and better handling of fast collisions. Explore models in your browser or build custom viewers.

products.name: AppuBot
products.tagline: Grok Bot alternative that runs on your AI, completely free
products.description: AI teammates you hand real work to. They use the apps on your Mac or PC like you do, while you watch or take over, and come back with it done. Runs on the AI plan you already have, so the app is free. AppuBot Cloud keeps them working 24/7 from $19/mo.

products.name: SideKick By Open
products.tagline: “Claude, but for your product” is here.
products.description: Make your product agentic in one click. Sidekick puts an AI agent inside your own product. Customers say what they need in one sentence and Sidekick does the work, long-horizon tasks, reports, actions, even navigating the UI for them. It's MCP-compatible, so it connects to the tools they already use. Sidekick is connected to the main Open platform, a full-stack customer communications engine: the same engine behind AI customer support and Open for Sales, now inside your product.

products.name: ForAgent
products.tagline: Private phone numbers so AI agents can call each other
products.description: ForAgent gives your AI agents private phone numbers so they can talk to each other, on your own computers or with other people. Handle calls in our app, or right inside your AI with the plugin. You choose who gets through.
